work_order: WO-020, the re-measurement moved first, ahead of docs/M3-design-draft.md's WO-020 and WO-021 split, per the owner's 'beginning with re-measuring'
decided_by: owner, 2026-11-06: M3's eight defaults (D1 to D8) accepted; start with the Mac work orders, beginning with re-measuring the -237% missed-grasp gap under the current model; freeze the M3 remeasurement protocol before its first run
already_seen: Plain A on WO-004's family-holdout weights was already evaluated in WO-005's stage 0 (runs/20261102T085542Z_4764e650, train_side, train data only). Worst reductions under plain A, over seeds 0 to 2, horizons 1 to 10 and both streams: missed-grasp -62.9%, on the joints at horizon 1, seed 0, unchanged by plain A; its cube is -0.5% (it was -237.1% before plain A). Early-release: 11.9% (cube); its joints are 72.4%. docs/M3-design-draft.md wrongly called this not run, and the owner's instruction relied on that. So this run is a reproduction of that measurement under a frozen protocol, not a blind re-measurement, and the target rule's outcome is known in advance: m0-scripted-missed-grasp, by its joints. On the cube alone it would still be selected (-0.5% against 11.9%). That run's dev information-only results are not used here. The owner is told this in the report of the run.
model: carry-contact-beta-fall-still-reach (plain A), applied at inference to WO-004's family-holdout ensembles of runs/20261102T041509Z_93dd348c (carry-contact-beta-fall, 30 epochs, seeds 0, 1 and 2). No retraining: plain A changes nothing that is trained.
data: the M0 train partition only (artifacts/manifests/m0-dataset-v1.json); each of the seven train families held out in turn, as in WO-004
metric: for family F, seed s, stream (joint_position or object_position, ET-M1-1's required streams, own units) and horizon h in 1 to 10: the reduction 1 - RMSE_model / RMSE of the lowest of the five baselines (constant, linear, nominal_hold, nominal_carry, nominal_carry_fall) at that horizon. W(F) is its minimum over seeds, streams and horizons. Also reported by phase, in millimetres and radians.
reproduction_check: on device mps, in the pinned robotics environment, for each of the seven family holdouts, each seed, each stream and each horizon, the new plain A reduction must equal train_side.<family>.seeds.<seed>.reductions.after.<stream>[h-1] of runs/20261102T085542Z_4764e650/m1_followups_v2.json within an absolute 1e-6 (420 values); otherwise stop, write a failure record and no result, and report
target_rule: If W(missed-grasp) >= 0.20 and W(early-release) >= 0.20, the result is that M1's motivation for M3 is weaker than it looked; it is reported, and the held-out test waits for the owner. Otherwise M3's target family for the held-out test is the one with the lower W; if the two are equal within 1e-9, it is m0-scripted-missed-grasp.
also_reported: for the target family, the stream, phase, horizon and seed that carry its worst value, so the M3 operators can aim at the error that remains
scored_once: a result is written only after the reproduction check passes; the tool refuses any run once a result exists. This file's sha256 is recorded in the status ledger before the first run.
